programs.title: The 90-Day Leakproof Program
programs.subtitle: Train real, lasting bladder control, one day at a time.

weeks.themeSubtitle: The original week: find, feel, and fire the muscles that keep you dry.

days.title: Activate Control
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by finding the right pelvic muscles and switching them on.

days.title: Build Support
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by using my glutes to take pressure off my pelvic floor.

days.title: Leak-Proof Power
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by asking my core to hold tight under pressure.

days.title: All-Day Endurance
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by building the stamina to stay dry from morning to night.

days.title: Control in Motion
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by keeping those muscles switched on while I move.

days.title: Everyday Strength
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by moving well through everyday tasks.

days.title: Total Confidence
days.intention: Today I stop bladder leaks by trusting myself to tighten on command.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Deepen your awareness of the pelvic floor and its breath connection.

days.title: The Quiet Engine
days.intention: You will practice clean squeezes: full squeeze, full release, and never hold your breath. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: The Back-Up Team
days.intention: Strong glutes lift pressure off your bladder, and today we build them on purpose. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Pressure Practice
days.intention: Controlled core work today trains your system to stay sealed under tension. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Breath & Squeeze
days.intention: Today's work tunes the timing between your inhale, exhale, and pelvic lift. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Stand, Lift, Go
days.intention: Today you take control out of the mat and into how you actually move all day. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Progressive Power
days.intention: A focused strength session today keeps your progress climbing week over week. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.
